test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: silence

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• Chaos means complete disorder and confusion. (पूर्ण विकार और भ्रम)
 
• Silence means the complete absence of sound. (ध्वनि की पूर्ण अनुपस्थिति)
 
• Din means a loud, unpleasant, and prolonged noise. (एक तेज, अप्रिय और लंबे समय तक चलने वाला शोर)
 
• Noise means a sound, especially one that is loud or unpleasant or that causes disturbance. (एक ध्वनि, विशेष रूप से एक जो जोर से या अप्रिय है या जो गड़बड़ी का कारण बनती है)
 
 
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: Each individual read aloud in a wonderful stillness that didn't feel forced or pressured in any way.
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given words, "silence" should be used in the given sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

Complete passage: *Our host started to read and the (1) chatter __stopped. There was a sweet **__(2) silence __**as each person read, not one that felt forced or imposed in any way. People did not seem to (3)_______ or cough, but perhaps that is just now I remember it now, I know I was increasingly self-conscious as the readings came closer to me and that when it was my turn I think I (4)________ through most of it, probably without making any sense of the (5)_________.*

57:T1079,

The correct answer is: **fidget**
